meta_title: BookWorm: Reading Tracker & Audiobook Log for iPhone
meta_desc: Track paper books, ebooks and audiobooks on iPhone and iPad. Set a daily reading goal, keep your streak, time each sitting and watch your year fill a shelf.
og_desc: A calm reading tracker for paper books, ebooks and audiobooks. Goals, streaks, a reading timer and your year on a shelf.

hero_lede: A calm companion for paper books, ebooks and audiobooks. Log a page in a second, keep your streak going, and watch your year fill a shelf.

how_title: A habit, one page at a time.

maker_q1: I built BookWorm for anyone who wants to finish the books they start: something gentle that notices the days you read, and never shames you for the days you didn't.
maker_q2: No ads, no account, nothing between you and your book.
maker_tip: BookWorm is made by one person. If it helps you read more, the tip jar inside the app keeps it growing.
maker_alt: Illustrated portrait of Adam, who makes BookWorm.
q1: Does it work with audiobooks and ebooks?
a1: Yes. Paper books and ebooks are tracked by the page, audiobooks by hours and minutes, and your daily goal counts all of them together.
q2: Do I need to make an account?
a2: No. BookWorm uses the Apple Account already on your iPhone, so there is nothing to sign up for.
q3: Will my books sync between my iPhone and iPad?
a3: Yes. Your library, reading days and goal sync through your own iCloud to every device signed in to the same Apple Account.
q4: What happens if I miss a day?
a4: Your streak starts again, and the next day is a fresh start. Reminders are calm: one at lunchtime, and a last call in the evening only when a streak is on the line.
q5: Can I track more than one book at a time?
a5: Yes. Every book you're reading sits on Home as a cover you can flip and update, and the reading timer works with whichever one is in your hands.
a6: English, Polish, Spanish, French, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean and Brazilian Portuguese. You can switch inside the app at any time.
q7: What happens to my reading data?
a7: Your books live on your device and in your own iCloud. BookWorm collects a small amount of pseudonymous usage data to improve the app, and never your book titles or notes. The privacy policy has every detail.
q8: Which devices does it run on?
a8: Any iPhone or iPad running iOS 17.2 or later, with widgets on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
close_text: Pick the book on your nightstand. BookWorm will keep the page.
